svg.desc: The browser and server save table lists to avoid repeated discovery. This sequence shows loading when saved information is needed, followed by explicit refresh. Database discovery is skipped when the server already has a saved copy. Refresh replaces saved copies only on success and does not update other tabs or servers.
svg.title: The table list — load once, reuse, and refresh

g.text: If refresh fails, keep the last good list. Other tabs and servers refresh separately.
1. Load the table and column list
2. Read the list if no server copy
